summary: IRGC attacks on commercial ships in Strait of Hormuz triggered diplomatic fallout as Iran's president demanded accountability from IRGC commander Vahidi, who denied authorization. Southern Saudi Arabia faces repeated drone and missile strikes with Khamis Mushait, Abha, Jizan, and Najran on alert. Lebanon sustained 12 air strikes and extensive artillery fire alongside 92 drone sightings in a single day.
key_points: IRGC attacked commercial ships in Hormuz early Tir, LNG tanker caught fire, other vessels damaged; Pezeshkian angered, demanded accountability from Vahidi who denied authorization and said NECSA/SNSC not informed. (Source: @VahidOnline/78360)

Southern Saudi Arabia under repeated drone/missile strikes; Khamis Mushait, Abha, Jizan, Najran on alert; Saudi civil defense reported danger then new missile strikes. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/391554)

Iranian commercial vessel attacked near Hengam Island, Hormuz, 1 dead 4 injured. (Source: @presstv/206664)

sections.threat_assessment: The Hormuz ship attacks by IRGC have created a diplomatic crisis within Iran as President Pezeshkian publicly confronted Vahidi, suggesting possible internal friction between civilian leadership and IRGC. Saudi Arabia faces an escalating asymmetric campaign with drone swarms and missiles hitting southern cities including Khamis Mushait, Abha, Jizan, and Najran, with civil defense reporting cycles of danger then new strikes. The destruction of Hezbollah's underground compound at Rades Ali Taher and Katz's declaration of Ali Taher as Israeli security zone raises risk of Hezbollah retaliation and a multi-front scenario. Yemeni gains at Bab al-Mandab threaten Saudi maritime logistics.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia and Jordan have warned Iraq that attacks from its soil will trigger direct strikes on armed groups inside Iraq, raising escalation risk with Baghdad. France and Lebanon are pushing to extend UNIFIL beyond December 31 despite Israeli opposition and possible US veto. Iran and Oman jointly postponed the Gulf foreign ministers meeting at request of regional countries, signaling diplomatic maneuvering around Hormuz tensions. BRICS summit initiatives by Xi and Pezeshkian's statements reflect efforts to build non-Western coalitions amid US-Iran confrontation.
sections.intelligence_notes: Discrepancy between two Red Alert Lebanon counts (17 vs 22 artillery shells) suggests reporting inconsistencies common in conflict-zone open-source data. The report that Chinese entities provided satellite imagery to Iran, with Trump's equivocal response, indicates potential great-power dimension to the conflict. Vahidi's denial of authorization for Hormuz attacks while Pezeshkian's anger suggests possible unauthorized IRGC action or internal Iranian power struggle. The off-duty soldier incident in al-Mughayyir highlights ongoing friction in West Bank beyond formal military operations.
